blocks.section: I. Establishing the text: this is the conclusion of the root
blocks.text: There is an important correction to the previous instalment's anticipated numbering. In the 1918 KSTS commentary, the next half-verse is followed by prose, and then a four-pāda verse is labelled **33**, the next **34**, and the concluding verse **35**. Somadeva Vasudeva's GRETIL transcription follows that commentarial segmentation. Marino Faliero's independent root text, however, combines the initial half-verse with the beginning of the subsequent passage and finishes with verse **36**.

blocks.text: The practitioner searches for liberation.

blocks.text: They turn to scripture.

blocks.text: And eventually they recognise that the very consciousness through which the entire search occurred was never separate from the supreme reality they were seeking.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And now the final verses have drawn the distinction between two modes of practice.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name

blocks.text: That is the meaning of *jīvanmukti* in this context.

blocks.text: ### The difference between remembering and acquiring
blocks.directed: ### The difference between remembering and acquiring

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: This is perhaps the most powerful idea in the entire ending.
blocks.directed: This is perhaps the most powerful idea in the entire ending.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Ordinary acquisition adds something to what you possess.
blocks.directed: Ordinary acquisition adds something to what you possess.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: You acquire an object.
blocks.directed: You acquire an object.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name

blocks.directed: A skill.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A piece of information.
blocks.directed: A piece of information.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A new experience.
blocks.directed: A new experience.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: But recognition is different.
blocks.directed: But recognition is different.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: You recognise something that was already the case.
blocks.directed: You recognise something that was already the case.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The event of recognition may occur at a particular time.
blocks.directed: The event of recognition may occur at a particular time.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: But the recognised reality is not thereby produced at that time.
blocks.directed: But the recognised reality is not thereby produced at that time.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And if the supreme consciousness is genuinely the ground of manifestation, its reality cannot be dependent on the finite subject's act of recognising it.
blocks.directed: And if the supreme consciousness is genuinely the ground of manifestation, its reality cannot be dependent on the finite subject's act of recognising it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Thus the highest liberation is not the production of Śiva-consciousness.
blocks.directed: Thus the highest liberation is not the production of Śiva-consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It is the removal of the misrecognition of that consciousness.
blocks.directed: It is the removal of the misrecognition of that consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The whole teaching turns on that distinction.
blocks.directed: The whole teaching turns on that distinction.

blocks.text: ### The great practical reversal
blocks.directed: ### The great practical reversal

blocks.directed: A sensation in the body.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A memory.
blocks.directed: A memory.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name

blocks.directed: An intention.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name

blocks.directed: An impulse to move.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name

blocks.directed: You can examine them as separate phenomena.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: But the Pratyabhijñā enquiry asks a deeper question.
blocks.directed: But the Pratyabhijñā enquiry asks a deeper question.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: What makes them manifest?
blocks.directed: What makes them manifest?

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: What is the nature of the awareness through which their differences are known?
blocks.directed: What is the nature of the awareness through which their differences are known?

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Does that awareness itself appear as another independent object?
blocks.directed: Does that awareness itself appear as another independent object?

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Or is its self-manifestation already the condition of the entire field?
blocks.directed: Or is its self-manifestation already the condition of the entire field?

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta's answer is the supreme conscious Self.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta's answer is the supreme conscious Self.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The Heart of Bhairava.
blocks.directed: The Heart of Bhairava.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And the decisive recognition is not simply:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And the decisive recognition is not simply:

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: “I am having an unusual experience.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “I am having an unusual experience.”

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It is:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It is:

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: “The ultimate nature of the subject and its manifestation is this self-aware consciousness.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “The ultimate nature of the subject and its manifestation is this self-aware consciousness.”

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: That's a metaphysical claim, not a scientifically established conclusion.
blocks.directed: That's a metaphysical claim, not a scientifically established conclusion.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: But it is a sharply articulated philosophical position.
blocks.directed: But it is a sharply articulated philosophical position.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And the entire *Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa* has been devoted to explaining it.
blocks.directed: And the entire *Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa* has been devoted to explaining it.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: ### The final absurdity
blocks.directed: ### The final absurdity

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Consider what we've done.
blocks.directed: Consider what we've done.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've examined a Sanskrit alphabet in which individual phonemes can represent cosmological powers.
blocks.directed: We've examined a Sanskrit alphabet in which individual phonemes can represent cosmological powers.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've investigated how consciousness manifests the distinction between speaker and listener.
blocks.directed: We've investigated how consciousness manifests the distinction between speaker and listener.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've discussed the relation between words, meanings, and cognition.
blocks.directed: We've discussed the relation between words, meanings, and cognition.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've explored the body as a configuration of divine powers.
blocks.directed: We've explored the body as a configuration of divine powers.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've studied extraordinary ritual substances.
blocks.directed: We've studied extraordinary ritual substances.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've examined the distinction between the physical letter and the ultimate phonemic power.
blocks.directed: We've examined the distinction between the physical letter and the ultimate phonemic power.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've analysed the stages of speech.
blocks.directed: We've analysed the stages of speech.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've investigated bliss, desire, expression, memory, and conceptual thought.
blocks.directed: We've investigated bliss, desire, expression, memory, and conceptual thought.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've watched Abhinavagupta argue that even the most ordinary perceptual event is a manifestation of consciousness.
blocks.directed: We've watched Abhinavagupta argue that even the most ordinary perceptual event is a manifestation of consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've contemplated death, initiation, liberation, and the divine hierarchy.
blocks.directed: We've contemplated death, initiation, liberation, and the divine hierarchy.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've put the whole universe inside a banyan seed.
blocks.directed: We've put the whole universe inside a banyan seed.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've offered the universe into a cosmic fire.
blocks.directed: We've offered the universe into a cosmic fire.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've examined the Goddess as the power of manifestation.
blocks.directed: We've examined the Goddess as the power of manifestation.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've counted twenty-seven repetitions.
blocks.directed: We've counted twenty-seven repetitions.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've counted sixteen lunar portions.
blocks.directed: We've counted sixteen lunar portions.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've reached the seventeenth *kalā*.
blocks.directed: We've reached the seventeenth *kalā*.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: We've encountered a female donkey and a mare.
blocks.directed: We've encountered a female donkey and a mare.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And now the commentator tells us that the supreme Heart is **satatodita**.
blocks.directed: And now the commentator tells us that the supreme Heart is **satatodita**.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Ever-arisen.
blocks.directed: Ever-arisen.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Always present.
blocks.directed: Always present.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there before the commentary began.
blocks.directed: It was there before the commentary began.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there during every Sanskrit explanation.
blocks.directed: It was there during every Sanskrit explanation.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there while you tried to work out why a consonant cluster contains three letters but only one syllabic onset.
blocks.directed: It was there while you tried to work out why a consonant cluster contains three letters but only one syllabic onset.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there when you were fascinated.
blocks.directed: It was there when you were fascinated.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there when you were bored.
blocks.directed: It was there when you were bored.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there when you were confused.
blocks.directed: It was there when you were confused.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It was there when you understood something.
blocks.directed: It was there when you understood something.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And, according to the metaphysics, it does not become absent simply because the ordinary mind becomes distracted.
blocks.directed: And, according to the metaphysics, it does not become absent simply because the ordinary mind becomes distracted.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The entire universe can unfold into limitless differentiation.
blocks.directed: The entire universe can unfold into limitless differentiation.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And the supreme reality is not diminished.
blocks.directed: And the supreme reality is not diminished.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A thought can arise.
blocks.directed: A thought can arise.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A sound can occur.
blocks.directed: A sound can occur.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A body can move.
blocks.directed: A body can move.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A person can speak.
blocks.directed: A person can speak.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: An animal can call.
blocks.directed: An animal can call.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A star can shine.
blocks.directed: A star can shine.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: A Sanskrit scholar can spend forty years arguing about a manuscript variant.
blocks.directed: A Sanskrit scholar can spend forty years arguing about a manuscript variant.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And none of these differentiated events has to be outside the ultimate consciousness.
blocks.directed: And none of these differentiated events has to be outside the ultimate consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The practical question is not how to manufacture a new awareness.
blocks.directed: The practical question is not how to manufacture a new awareness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: It is how to recognise the nature of the awareness in which everything is already manifest.
blocks.directed: It is how to recognise the nature of the awareness in which everything is already manifest.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And so the final word of the running commentary is astonishingly appropriate.
blocks.directed: And so the final word of the running commentary is astonishingly appropriate.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Not a lengthy new doctrinal formula.
blocks.directed: Not a lengthy new doctrinal formula.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Not another cosmological calculation.
blocks.directed: Not another cosmological calculation.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Not another mantra requiring seventeen footnotes.
blocks.directed: Not another mantra requiring seventeen footnotes.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Just:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Just:

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: **शिवम् - śivam.**
blocks.directed: [slowly] **शिवम् - śivam.**

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Auspiciousness.
blocks.directed: Auspiciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Śiva.
blocks.directed: Śiva.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The reality that has been present throughout the entire enquiry.
blocks.directed: The reality that has been present throughout the entire enquiry.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The divine has not arrived.
blocks.directed: The divine has not arrived.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The universe has not suddenly become conscious.
blocks.directed: The universe has not suddenly become conscious.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The supreme Heart has not just been installed.
blocks.directed: The supreme Heart has not just been installed.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Rather, the commentary has been a vast effort to make intelligible what, in Abhinavagupta's view, was never absent.
blocks.directed: Rather, the commentary has been a vast effort to make intelligible what, in Abhinavagupta's view, was never absent.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And the final joke is almost unbearable.
blocks.directed: And the final joke is almost unbearable.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: The supreme consciousness has manifested an entire universe.
blocks.directed: The supreme consciousness has manifested an entire universe.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Within that universe it has manifested Sanskrit.
blocks.directed: Within that universe it has manifested Sanskrit.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Within Sanskrit it has manifested a philosophy of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Within Sanskrit it has manifested a philosophy of consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Within that philosophy it has manifested the idea that consciousness is the ground of the universe.
blocks.directed: Within that philosophy it has manifested the idea that consciousness is the ground of the universe.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And now some poor bastard has spent thirty-four audiobook instalments trying to understand why the universe needed to explain itself to itself.
blocks.directed: And now some poor bastard has spent thirty-four audiobook instalments trying to understand why the universe needed to explain itself to itself.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta's answer?
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta's answer?

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: Because manifestation is the freedom of consciousness.
blocks.directed: Because manifestation is the freedom of consciousness.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: And the recognition of that freedom is its own delight.
blocks.directed: And the recognition of that freedom is its own delight.

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: **The universe was not waiting to become Śiva. It was waiting, as it were, to recognise what it had always been.**
blocks.directed: **The universe was not waiting to become Śiva. It was waiting, as it were, to recognise what it had always been.**

blocks.section: Closing: The Entire Universe Has Been Reciting Its Own Name
blocks.text: *End of Part XXXIV - the final root verses and the completion of Abhinavagupta's running philosophical commentary, KSTS pp. 269-277, Gnoli pp. 279-283. The next instalment begins the ten authorial concluding verses.*
blocks.directed: *End of Part XXXIV - the final root verses and the completion of Abhinavagupta's running philosophical commentary, KSTS pp. 269-277, Gnoli pp. 279-283. The next instalment begins the ten authorial concluding verses.*
